rules.rationale: Defines the zero-depth empty-suffix base case of the named mathematical summary bracketResult.
Defines bracketResult on an empty suffix at positive depth as the unbalanced result false.
Completes the total definition of bracketResult on an empty suffix at negative depth.
Defines the recurrence for an opening bracket at depth zero by consuming it and continuing at depth one.
Defines the failure case for consuming a non-opening character when the current depth is zero.
Defines the positive-depth opening-bracket recurrence of bracketResult by incrementing the summary depth.
Defines the positive-depth non-opening recurrence of bracketResult by decrementing the summary depth.
Completes the total bracketResult definition by making a negative depth an absorbing false result.
Executes the program's literal-Boolean return form by setting the return state and moving to the existing #pop control state.
Executes the program-specific final depth comparison and return as a verification-model macro-step over the current scope.
Observes the current one-character bracket value and routes the program's equality test to the true #branch state.
Observes a non-opening current character and routes the program's bracket equality test to the false #branch state.
Executes the concrete depth += 1 statement by updating the depth binding in the modeled local scope.
Executes the concrete depth -= 1 statement by updating the depth binding in the modeled local scope.
Observes a negative depth and routes the program's depth comparison to the true #branch state.
Observes a nonnegative depth and routes the program's depth comparison to the false #branch state.
Executes function-frame popping in the verification model, restoring the continuation and caller state while normalizing deletion of the fresh scope.
